texto: It has a result consistent with a quality or experience: name + **だけ あって** / sentence + **だけ あって**. It may be praise, but not necessarily: **プロ だけあって、 じょうず です** (as expected from a professional, it is good).
To say that something is like this precisely by a feature: **ゆうめい な だけ に、 ひと が おおい です** (precisely because it is famous, there are many people).
He goes with the two of us after adjectives in-na.
It values that the quality or the result corresponds to the reputation, experience or effort: **あれ だけ れんしゅう した だけ の こと は ある** (with all that you practiced, you can see the result).
It is not only praising the effort.
